description.en: Circuit diagram of a full-wave rectifier using a center-tapped transformer and two p-n junction diodes.
description.hi: एक सेंटर-टैप्ड ट्रांसफार्मर और दो p-n संधि डायोड का उपयोग करके पूर्ण-तरंग दिष्टकारी का परिपथ आरेख।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 500 350" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- AC Source -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="175" r="20" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
  <path d="M35,175 Q42.5,165 50,175 T65,175" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="30" y="215" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">AC In</text>

  <!-- Primary Coil -->
  <line x1="70" y1="175" x2="100" y2="175" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
  <line x1="100" y1="100" x2="100" y2="250" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
  <path d="M100,100 Q120,110 100,120 Q120,130 100,140 Q120,150 100,160 Q120,170 100,180 Q120,190 100,200 Q120,210 100,220 Q120,230 100,240 Q120,250 100,250" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Core lines -->
  <line x1="130" y1="90" x2="130" y2="260" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" />
  <line x1="140" y1="90" x2="140" y2="260" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Secondary Coil -->
  <path d="M170,90 Q150,102 170,114 Q150,126 170,138 Q150,150 170,162 Q150,175 170,175 Q150,188 170,200 Q150,212 170,224 Q150,236 170,248 Q150,260 170,260" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
  <line x1="170" y1="90" x2="220" y2="90" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
  <line x1="170" y1="260" x2="220" y2="260" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Center Tap -->
  <line x1="155" y1="175" x2="320" y2="175" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
  <circle cx="155" cy="175" r="3" fill="#000" />

  <!-- Diode D1 -->
  <polygon points="220,75 220,105 250,90" fill="#ef4444" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <line x1="250" y1="75" x2="250" y2="105" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="225" y="65" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">D₁</text>

  <!-- Diode D2 -->
  <polygon points="220,245 220,275 250,260" fill="#ef4444" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <line x1="250" y1="245" x2="250" y2="275" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="225" y="295" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">D₂</text>

  <!-- Connecting Wires -->
  <line x1="250" y1="90" x2="320" y2="90" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
  <line x1="250" y1="260" x2="320" y2="260" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
  <line x1="320" y1="90" x2="320" y2="135" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
  <line x1="320" y1="260" x2="320" y2="215" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Load Resistor R_L -->
  <path d="M320,135 L310,145 L330,155 L310,165 L330,175 L310,185 L330,195 L310,205 L320,215" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="340" y="180" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#3b82f6">R_L</text>

  <!-- Output Voltage Indicator -->
  <circle cx="320" cy="135" r="3" fill="#000" />
  <circle cx="320" cy="215" r="3" fill="#000" />
  <line x1="320" y1="135" x2="390" y2="135" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="2,2" />
  <line x1="320" y1="215" x2="390" y2="215" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="2,2" />
  <text x="400" y="180" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">V_out (DC)</text>

</svg>
